title: Final Answer for s_z
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly show that s_z^2 = s_z.

title: Final Answer for (s_x ± i s_y)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must demonstrate that (s_x + i s_y)^3 = 0 and (s_x - i s_y)^3 = 0.

title: Matrix Representation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide the correct matrix forms for s_x, s_y, and s_z.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the calculations leading to the final answers clearly.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as sign errors in matrix multiplication.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios for spin operators.
